rationale: No record change. I considered the remaining directions rather than filing a speculative one: the configuration mechanism (a new voter starts with Match 0 so it cannot contribute to a commit quorum, and its RecentActive starts true to avoid a spurious quorum-check step-down), the removal path (a removed leader drops proposals because its own progress is gone, and its commit computation uses the new quorum only), and the append flow-control counters. Each either follows from branches already cited in the account or has no reachable failure state that the surrounding code does not correct, so recording them would add vocabulary rather than judgment. The record set already answers what was asked: one asserted defect with seven receipts plus a reproduction, a refuted progress-axis suspicion with its protective mechanism, eight supporting questions each with hypotheses, discriminators and interpretations tied to receipts or cited ranges, and the residual items stated as scope limits. Nothing is filed this turn and no attempt is made to declare the work complete, since that call belongs to a preconfigured finite task and to the run boundary.
